text:
elaine: Quick standup need a minimal ops pack for launch posts: 1) KW list 2) JSON-LD for webinar & benchmark pages 3) internal-link matrix (seed->clusters) 4) redirects for legacy slugs. Lock by EOD Fri.
marco: I can own KW + anchor CSV. Will target 12 priority queries (features, benchmark, integration).
jamal: I'll draft Event + Article snippets. Event example to paste in <head>: <script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Launch Webinar","startDate":"2026-04-14T17:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar"}}</script>
sophia: Redirects sheet updated with pre-2024 /blog/* slugs. Proposal: 302 test 10 days -> convert to 301. Shared drive link in comments.
elaine: @sophia add "anchor_rewrite" column to map CTAs to /webinar and /demo-request. Keep top-funnel posts to single CTA.
seo-bot: crawl-scan: benchmark-drafts -> 5 missing alt texts; 1 internal 404. See sheet.
marco: will fix alts and output CSV columns: source_url,target_url,anchor_text,reason by 15:00 PST.
jamal: validate JSON-LD with Rich Results Test when live; I'll run smoke validation.
sophia: infra rollout window requested 02:00-04:00 UTC for redirect push.
elaine: Final checklist: marco KW+CSV, jamal schemas+validation, sophia redirects+infra ticket, me copy+CTA placement. Keep messaging tight and single CTA on promo posts. :rocket:
